intro.title: Counter App
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple counter application using Vue. You will learn how to create a reactive state variable to hold the count, and how to update it with button clicks. The core concept is reactivity, where the UI automatically updates when the state changes. You will use Vue's ref function for state management and event handlers to increment and decrement the counter. This project introduces the fundamentals of component structure and user interaction in Vue.
intro.usecase: The pattern of managing and displaying a numeric value that changes based on user interaction is foundational across countless real-world applications. You'll see it in e-commerce product quantity selectors, social media like/dislike counters, dashboard metrics that update in real-time, and media player volume controls. As a developer, implementing this counter teaches you the core Vue reactivity system, which is essential for building dynamic interfaces like shopping carts, polling widgets, or any interactive data display.
